correctness.rationale: Let A=lambda I+S. Since A is invertible, N=[L,L] and is preserved by derivations; comparing the identity on [v,x] gives BA-AB=aA with a the x component of d(x). Its trace is ak lambda, so a=0 in characteristic zero. A map commuting with S is determined by its value on the cyclic vector e_1; each such value uniquely equals p(S)e_1 for a polynomial of degree below k. Conversely, arbitrary d(x) in N and B=p(S) give derivations. Locality on e_j forces Delta(e_j) into F_j and on x forces Delta(x) into N. If v in N is nonzero with first nonzero entry j, the columns v,Sv,...,S^(k-j)v have leading coefficient v_j in successive rows, hence span F_j over K. Every flag-preserving B therefore satisfies Bv=p_v(S)v pointwise. For y=alpha x+v with alpha nonzero, use a derivation vanishing on N with value Delta(y)/alpha on x; y=0 is automatic. This proves all three dimensions by counting entries, including k=1 where both spaces have dimension two. The supplied verify.py was inspected, not executed; the finite checks through k=8 are illustrative and unnecessary to the symbolic result.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Keep that displayed coefficient matrix and replace only the right-hand side by arbitrary b in F_j for v with first nonzero coordinate j. The leading square system on F_j has determinant v_j^(k-j+1), so every such b occurs, and no vector outside F_j does. Consequently locality on basis vectors is exactly flag preservation; vectors with nonzero x coefficient are unconstrained beyond the image lying in N. The frozen dimensions then count the entries of this triangular space and the ordinary Toeplitz subspace. This establishes mechanical coverage, not merely precedent for a non-derivation example.
